sin.name: ternary-statement
sin.description: A bare conditional expression as a statement (`cond ? doThis() : doThat()`): its value is never read, so it chooses an action, not a value
sin.rule: Choose an action with `if`/`else`; a conditional expression chooses a value, so never write one whose value nothing reads.
sin.suggestion: An `if` with each side as its own body, and no `else` at all when one side did nothing.
